::: callout-note
Zenodo's terms can sometimes be a bit confusing. The two main terms are:

- Deposit: A Zenodo deposit is the combined set of files and metadata that make
  up the content that will eventually form a published record. For a given
  output (e.g. an academic paper), there is only one Deposit.
- Record: A Zenodo record is a given published set of metadata and files for a
  specific DOI. There can be multiple records for any given deposit. A record is
  something you can't change.
:::
